The suite passes now: 16 of 16 tests, exit 0. It was failing 4 before. I changed only code under `slugkit/` and didn't touch the tests.

| Failing test | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `test_unicode_folding` | Accented letters were replaced with separators instead of being turned into plain letters (SPEC 1.1) | `slug.py`: split accented letters into base letter plus accent, then drop everything non-ASCII |
| `test_punctuation_runs_collapse`, `test_custom_separator` | Each punctuation character became its own separator, so `--` showed up in slugs (SPEC 1.2) | `slug.py`: a whole run of non-letters/digits now becomes one separator, and separators at the start and end are removed |
| `test_cuts_at_word_boundary` | An off-by-one meant a separator sitting exactly at `max_len` was never used as a cut point (SPEC 2.2) | `truncate.py`: extended the search range by one character |
